title: Job's Restoration
description: God speaks to Job out of the storm and reveals His almighty power through creation, Behemoth and Leviathan. Job humbles himself and repents in dust and ashes. God rebukes Job's friends, and after Job prays for them, God restores everything Job had lost, doublefold.
